title: Range, List, and Hash Partitioning
summary: Use range, list, and hash partitioning to decide, build, and operate PostgreSQL partitions only when the workload evidence supports the cost.
learning_objectives: Explain range, list, and hash partitioning in operational PostgreSQL terms.
Verify pruning, retention, or index behavior with concrete SQL evidence.
Reject premature partitioning when the table lifecycle does not justify it.
reflection_prompts: What evidence makes partitioning worth its operational cost?
What would tell you the design should be simplified?

references.why: Phase 9 operational guide and retention template.
